CREATE VIEW [DW].[FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD_1Year_View] 
	AS 

WITH FactADB_Latest AS (
SELECT AccountSK
,max(FADBL.BusinessDateSK) AS LatestBusinessDateSK
,max(FADBL.BusinessDateSK) - 10000 AS EarliestBusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD as FADBL
GROUP BY ACCOUNTSK
)

Select ADB.*
from DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD as ADB
    INNER JOIN FactADB_Latest as FADBL
        ON FADBL.AccountSK = ADB.AccountSK
    WHERE ADB.BusinessdateSK BETWEEN FADBL.EarliestBusinessDateSK AND FADBL.LatestBusinessDateSK
